Notes: EchoJEPA ViT-L (vendored in models/deepcoro_model/echojepa_src, MIT) with SYNTAX segment masks and tracked crops; at most 2 encoder passes per study. No dataset mean/std here: grayscale frames are scaled to [0,1] and ImageNet-normalised inside the model (integrated_model.normalize_clip). occluded_operating_point: the '100% (occluded)' display threshold of thresholds.json occluded_prob (v19.2: 0.50, PI on validation), epicardial segments only. stent_annotation_threshold: P(stent visible) above which a segment is annotated 'possible stent' (annotation only, no flag or grade changes; v19-derived: 95% specificity among untreated segments on the v19 e2 validation post-PCI rows (25,222 segments, 2,469 treated; sensitivity .436, PPV .486), DeepCoro stent_guard_v19).
